one_liner: Waterfall.io offers a REST contact/company enrichment API with x-api-key auth, but keys are issued only after a team approval review, so there is no self-serve path.
auth_notes: Static API key sent in the x-api-key header. A master key can create sub-keys. No OAuth is documented.
access_notes: API access is by approval. You request a key via work email on the homepage or book a call, and the team reviews every request. There is no documented self-serve signup or free tier. Billing is prepaid top-up, but you still need approval first. The pricing-page quote in the draft is not in the fetched pages, so it was dropped.
blocker_notes: Keys require team approval after a conversation about use case and volume. The only agent tooling in the pages is "Agent Skills" on GitHub, which is not an MCP server. The Databar MCP server cited in the draft is a different vendor's product and does not appear in the fetched pages.

evidence.quote: Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header.
Creating and managing sub-keys requires a **master API key**.

API access is available by approval. Request a key through the email field on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/), or book a call to discuss your workflow. A member of our team reviews every access request.
[Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.
We offer a prepaid model, where you can top up your Waterfall account, and each successful match reduces your balance.
The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header.
